resources.string:
Health data in My Fitness Diary

What MFD reads
With your permission (you can allow each one separately), MFD reads from Health Connect: sleep, steps, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, weight, body fat and, only if you switch it on in Cycle & Health, period days (menstruation and flow). It reads nothing else.

How it is used
• Recovery check-ins (Progress → Recovery): hours slept, steps, resting heart rate and heart-rate variability for the last 7 days. Sleep is only filled in on days you haven't entered it yourself.
• Your workouts: heart rate during each workout (average, maximum, zones and a graph).
• Weigh-ins: weight and body fat measured by your scale or watch, on days you haven't entered them yourself.
• Cycle & Health (women only, when switched on): period days and their flow, added only on days you haven't logged yourself and marked as from Health Connect. MFD never writes cycle data to Health Connect.
MFD reads this only while the app is open.

What MFD saves to Health Connect
Only if you turn it on (Settings → Health & devices, separately for each): your finished workouts (name, start and end time, and the heart rate your watch recorded in MFD), and the food you log (name, meal, calories, protein, carbs, fat, sugars, saturated fat, fibre and sodium). Other apps you allow in Health Connect (Samsung Health, Fitbit…) can then show them. Changes and deletions in MFD are passed on. Turning it off stops saving; what was saved stays in Health Connect until you delete it there.

Where it goes
These values are saved in your own diary, in your MFD account, like everything else you log. They are not shared with friends, not used for ads, and never sold. If you connect ChatGPT or Claude to MFD, they can read only what you allow on MFD's connect page: Recovery (sleep, steps, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability and your check-ins), Workouts (each workout's average and maximum heart rate) and Body weight (weigh-ins, including ones from Health Connect). Cycle & Health is never shared with them unless you switch on its own AI permission there. Nothing else goes to them.

Your control
You can stop at any time: Health Connect → App permissions → My Fitness Diary. Check-ins already filled in stay in your diary until you delete them (Progress → Recovery → ⋮ → Delete check-in).
